metadata.description: Mods do Claude Code (function hooks) feitos para uso diário: modelo certo para subagentes, revisão com prova, próximos passos, painel ao vivo, lixeira e varredura de segredos antes do push.

plugins.name: sonnet-por-padrao
plugins.description: Subagent and Workflow agents created without an explicit model run on Sonnet instead of inheriting Opus; Opus only when asked on purpose

plugins.name: revisor-com-prova
plugins.description: When a reviewer (Codex, agy, council) returns, reminds Claude that a finding without evidence does not count and must be reproduced before fixing

plugins.name: proximos-passos
plugins.description: After each answer, Haiku proposes three next requests as buttons above the prompt (keys 1-3)

plugins.name: painel-vivo
plugins.description: Glanceable live pane: pending items, warnings and a worker tree (subagents, Workflow agents, commands, agy, Codex) with model, tokens and current step; other busy sessions; rate limits

plugins.name: lixeira
plugins.description: Turns permanent deletes into the system trash and blocks no-way-back commands (git reset --hard, push --force, format) until the user says yes

plugins.name: varredura-push
plugins.description: Before git push or gh publishing, scans the commits about to leave for keys, tokens and passwords (gitleaks, with fallback rules) and blocks the push on a hit
